prompt: A user whose account was deleted in one region and who then signs up again in a sibling region gets stuck in an infinite sign-in loop: the flow bounces between the login page and the identity endpoint and never completes. A cached session short-circuits the provider sign-in using an account id that no longer resolves. Detect the stale cached session, clear it, and fall through to a real provider sign-in so the live identity is resolved. Keep the fix minimal.
brain_queries: infinite login redirect loop after account deletion
cached idp session stale account id short-circuit
cross-region account re-signup shared accounts pool
oauth short-circuit skip provider roundtrip account not found
session validation before marking auth request done
_subject: core/api: drop stale idp_session before OAuth short-circuit (#1688)
